story_zh: 王经理提前安排会议，保证按时举行。他详细说明所有条件，并按照表格提供信息。律师表示理解，并接受正式合同。同时，他提醒大家要礼貌交流，避免浪费交通时间。结果，会议效果理想，大家有信心完成生意。
story_pinyin: Wáng jīnglǐ tíqián ānpái huìyì, bǎozhèng ànshí jǔxíng. Tā xiángxì shuōmíng suǒyǒu tiáojiàn, bìng ànzhào biǎogé tígōng xìnxī. Lǜshī biǎoshì lǐjiě, bìng jiēshòu zhèngshì hétóng. Tóngshí, tā tíxǐng dàjiā yào lǐmào jiāoliú, bìmiǎn làngfèi jiāotōng shíjiān. Jiéguǒ, huìyì xiàoguǒ lǐxiǎng, dàjiā yǒu xìnxīn wánchéng shēngyì.
story_en: Manager Wang arranged the meeting in advance to guarantee it would be held on time. He explained all conditions in detail and provided information according to the form. The lawyer expressed understanding and accepted the formal contract. At the same time, he reminded everyone to communicate politely and avoid wasting transportation time. As a result, the meeting effect was ideal, and everyone had confidence in completing the business.
